{{Quote|Confer on you the level of Jedi Knight, the Council does. But agree with your taking this boy as your Padawan learner, I do not.|Yoda speaking to Obi-Wan Kenobi inside the turret room attached to the temple|audio=Yoda-Confer.flac|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Theed temple''' was a small temple attached to [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. A small chamber called the [[Turret Room/Legends|Turret Room]] was attached to the temple. It was built by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]]<ref name="Inside" />after the beginning of the [[Great Time of Peace/Legends|Great Time of Peace]] in [[832 BBY/Legends|832 BBY]].<ref name="Nexus">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> Naboo's later [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|rulers]] would pay homage to their predecessors inside the temple,<ref name="Inside" /> and others would use the Turret Room to mourn lost heroes and celebrate their lives. Three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the end of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] met with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] inside the temple, where Yoda discussed the decisions of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|knight]] Kenobi following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|death]] of his master, [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], and debated the [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] of the newfound [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] child [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="TPM novel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Theed temple first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] by [[Terry Brooks]],<ref name="TPM novel" /> released on [[April 21]], [[1999]].<ref name="Noveldate">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The novel states that the temple is in close proximity to where Jinn's body lay in state prior to his [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|cremation]],<ref name="TPM novel" /> but the film itself and other sources portray the temple as attached to Theed Royal Palace.<ref name="Inside" /><ref name="TPM" />
